h1: Drywall Repair Cost in Sugar Land & Fort Bend County
bodyHtml:
Drywall Repair Cost in Sugar Land & Fort Bend County

Most drywall repair projects start at our $650 job minimum and are priced per repair based on the size and type of damage. Below are the real per-repair ranges we use across Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond, Katy, Fulshear, Rosenberg, and West Houston.

Quick Drywall Repair Price Breakdown

Nail Pops & Small Cracks
$95 – $126 / repair
Larger Cracks
$120 – $160 / repair
Holes (1–3 sq ft)
$195 – $259 / repair
Holes (4–8 sq ft)
$25 – $32 / sq ft

$650 job minimum applies. Repairs are matched to your existing wall texture and left primed and paint-ready.

Schedule My Free Estimate

What Drives Drywall Repair Cost

  • Size and type of damage: a nail pop is a quick fix; a large hole needs backing, patching, and texture.

  • Texture matching: knockdown, orange peel, and smooth finishes each take different skill and time to blend invisibly.

  • Ceiling vs. wall: overhead repairs are slower and require more protection.

  • Number of repairs: several repairs in one visit are more efficient than scattered single fixes.

  • Paint-ready vs. painted: we leave every repair primed; repainting the wall or room is quoted separately.

Good / Better / Best

Good — Spot Repair

$95 – $126 / repair

Fast fixes for the small stuff.

  • Nail pops & small cracks
  • Texture matched to your wall
  • Sanded and left primed, paint-ready

Better — Standard Repair

$120 – $259 / repair

Cracks and small holes restored cleanly.

  • Larger cracks ($120–$160)
  • Holes 1–3 sq ft ($195–$259)
  • Backing, patching, and texture blend
  • Primed and paint-ready

Best — Full Restoration

$25 – $32 / sq ft

Larger damage rebuilt right.

  • Holes 4–8 sq ft
  • New backing and reinforced patching
  • Full texture match across the area
  • Primed and ready for paint

Every option carries our $650 job minimum and our 2 & 5-Year Written Warranty on the work.

What's Included

  • Protection of floors, furniture, and surrounding areas

  • Patching, backing, and reinforcement as needed

  • Texture matching to your existing finish

  • Priming so the repair is paint-ready

  • Cleanup and final walkthrough

Schedule My Free Estimate

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does drywall repair cost?

Most repairs run between $95 and $259 per repair depending on size, with larger holes priced at $25–$32 per square foot. A $650 job minimum applies.

Is there a minimum charge?

Yes. Our drywall job minimum is $650, which covers setup, protection, materials, and the quality of finish our repairs are known for.

Do you match my wall texture?

Yes. We blend knockdown, orange peel, and smooth textures so the repair disappears once painted.

Do you paint the wall after repairing it?

We leave every repair primed and paint-ready. Repainting the wall or room is quoted separately so you only pay for what you need.

Ready for an Exact Drywall Repair Quote?

We'll inspect the damage, explain your options, and hand you a clear written estimate — no pressure.

Schedule Your Estimate
